assumptions: Rogers and Huff's dosage correlation needs no phase; haplotype r-squared and D-prime assume the maximum-likelihood two-locus frequencies.
Samples are from one population: structure inflates LD.
limits: LD is a property of this sample, not of the species.
Pruning depends on the window and threshold, which the answer states.
bio.jane/contract.question: How much linkage disequilibrium is there between each pair of biallelic sites, and which sites survive pruning?

description: Linkage disequilibrium between every pair of biallelic sites of a call set: the dosage correlation r of Rogers and Huff (scikit-allel), or haplotype r² and D′ from the maximum-likelihood two-locus haplotype frequencies (PLINK 1.9 --r2 dprime-signed), plus LD pruning by sliding windows (scikit-allel locate_unlinked). Validated on every pair of 1000 Genomes phase 3 APOL1 sites.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

end.description: last position (1-based) of the window; 0 is the last site.

estimator.description: rogersHuff: r between alt-allele dosages, no phasing (scikit-allel). haplotype: r² and D′ from the maximum-likelihood haplotype frequencies (PLINK 1.9). Values: rogersHuff (Rogers–Huff r (genotype dosages)), haplotype (Haplotype r² and D′ (maximum likelihood)).

group.description: compute over this group's samples only; empty is every sample.

groupBy.description: which column of the sample table groups the samples; empty is its first grouping column.

maxSites.description: refuse more sites than this: the pair count grows with its square.

minMac.description: keep sites where REF and the first ALT are each seen at least this many times (scikit-allel is_biallelic_01 min_mac).

populations.description: a sample table: a header row with a `sample` column and one or more grouping columns (tab-separated, as 1000 Genomes' .panel). Samples it does not list belong to no group.

pruneSize.description: LD pruning window, in sites (locate_unlinked size).

pruneStep.description: sites the pruning window advances (locate_unlinked step).

pruneThreshold.description: prune the later site of a pair whose Rogers–Huff r² exceeds this (locate_unlinked threshold).

start.description: first position (1-based) of the window; 0 is the first site.

vcf.description: the call set as VCF text (a .vcf, or a .vcf.gz already decompressed); every record's GT is read, ploidy 2.

name: linkage_disequilibrium

pairs.description: condensed upper triangle, pair (i, j > i) in row order: r (rogersHuff) or [r², D′] (haplotype), null where a site is monomorphic among the samples called at both

sites.description: the sites compared, in order: index into the call set, chrom, pos, ref, alt, and whether pruning kept it

summary.description: sites, pairs, mean r², pairs at r² ≥ 0.8, pruning kept, and the strongest pairs
